options.description: Write output to file instead of stdout. For image  results, decodes and saves as binary file.

arguments.name: ACTION
arguments.description: The action to perform

commands.description: Slide master commands: read/edit the title and body  placeholder fonts on the presentation's slide master, and read/edit the  slide master's background fill color. Operates within an already-open .  Changes here apply to every slide that inherits from the master (i.e. any slide  that does not itself override the property), which is the practical "edit  the master, not each slide" workflow PowerPoint's COM object model  supports safely.
